final: WITH patient_level AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS patient_avg_alb, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS patient_avg_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(patient_avg_ratio) AS avg_un_tbil_ratio FROM patient_level GROUP BY SEX), with_mean AS (SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, AVG(avg_alb) OVER () AS mean_sex_avg_alb FROM sex_level) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_un_tbil_ratio, avg_alb - mean_sex_avg_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM with_mean WHERE avg_alb > mean_sex_avg_alb
